abi.convert_function: spine_converter_convert(input_file, output_file, target_version, output_format, remove_curve, error_buffer, error_buffer_size)

notes: The vendored C++ readers, writers, and cross-family conversion passes are from the fixed upstream commit.
The upstream Python helper is a batch driver; this package adds a small C ABI wrapper so the application can call the same native conversion in-process.
The generated DLL is a local build artifact and is not required to be committed with the source tree.
